Name: Baby Pets
Author: DellyBelly
Description:
[b]Baby Pets[/b] is the start of a framework to allow CP mods to add baby versions of pets.


[size=5][b]How to Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]

[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿

[*]Download and unzip the mod into [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i]
>> alternatively consider using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop [/url]﻿to manage your mods
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[size=5][b]Use[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]For Players[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]This mod does nothing on its own, you need to install content packs that require this mod.
(See [i]Requirements > Mods requiring this file[/i] above ^)[*]You can edit the config.json to modify the amount of days you would like your pets to be babies. Default: 28 days.
[/list]
[size=4][b]For Mod Authors[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]This framework is still a work in progress. 
[*]If you would like to contribute, or request tokens for your CP please feel free to contact me here or in the Stardew Valley Discord @delly.belly
[/list]

[size=5][b]Known Issues[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]If you have 2 pets with the same type & breed, they will always be the same life-stage (baby/adult)
[*]BUG: first day the pet arrives, it will be an adult >> it becomes a baby the next day. (working on fix)

[/list]
[size=5][b]Compatability[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[/list]
[size=5][b]Thank you[/b][/size]
If you've made it this far and you install the mod, thank you. I hope you enjoy it.
And of course a big thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url] ﻿for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
